mostWorthwhile.text: Making the imagined beast was most worthwhile: familiar memories and story became something not previously in the world, paying off the chapter's creative hook.

leastWorthwhile.text: The song-to-melody passage felt slightly backward and was a predictable, only-offered step.

surprise.text: Call and air produced a song immediately; I expected a more basic musical element first.

arbitrary.text: Song plus memory becoming melody felt less clear than the other combinations, especially because the song already existed.

continue.text: I would continue to see what else the world's inhabitants create independently, though the forced sequence made this chapter's decisions fairly limited.
